applicabilityBasis.summary: USCC represents restricted private-fund shares offered under Securities Act Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D Rule 506. Variable NAV redemption does not create a fixed-value payment claim. The GENIUS Act's securities exclusion applies to the fund-share instrument; no payment-stablecoin issuer authorization is asserted.

genius.issuerEntity: Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund, a series of a Delaware Statutory Trust
genius.notes: USCC is assessed as a restricted investment-fund share, independently of the regulatory status of its underlying USDC or custodians. Public issuer disclosures describe a Delaware Statutory Trust series, securities-law offering exemptions and variable NAV redemption. The GENIUS Act excludes securities from payment stablecoins. MiCA financial-instrument exclusion is separately supported by ESMA's technology-neutral collective-investment-unit criteria; neither assessment asserts issuer licensing or retail access.
